headline: AfDB Withdraws K52.7 Billion as Malawi Faces Mounting Donor Compliance Concerns | Nyasa Times
summary: Malawi has lost about K52.705 billion in African Development Bank funding after the institution revised its African Development Fund downward. Donor compliance concerns are mounting.
why: The African Development Bank is a multilateral lender, and reductions in its concessional funding affect public investment and budget planning in member countries.
